source_text: Lemma Luke 1:6. (Jerome Latin per Rauer GCS 35; working note for condensed tip.)
pass_a_gloss: Homily 2 on Luke 1:6: Zacharias and Elizabeth righteous (Luke 1:6)
pass_b_english: On [[they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments >> Bible:Luke 1:6]]: righteousness is not a show for people but walking blameless before God; the priestly pair models obedience without which the forerunner’s birth is not understood.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
